inputs.story: The Springfield County Bird Club met today, and several of its members brought their newest acquisitions. Match each girl to her newest bird - determine its species and the town and month in which it was purchased. Remember, as with all grid-based logic puzzles, no option in any category will ever be used more than once.
inputs.constraints:
1. Of the parrot and the lorikeet, one was bought in April and the other is Roberta's.
2. Natalie's pet was bought sometime before Roberta's pet.
3. Laura's pet is the lovebird.
4. The bird bought in February is either the lorikeet or the lovebird.
5. Of the bird bought in February and the macaw, one is Natalie's and the other is Roberta's.

months: January; February; March; April.
names: Celia; Laura; Natalie; Roberta.
birds: lorikeet; lovebird; macaw; parrot.

january	natalie	macaw 
april	celia	parrot
